However, in early October, our bank was disconnected and required reconnection. This has happened from time to time. This time, transactions from that “reconnection” point on never came through. We contacted Rocket Money on three occasions as well as our bank to check on all possible issues. We were told to actively disconnect and reconnect. We did, and now ALL data is lot going back all the way. We are still unable to see any transactions. I’d love connecting with a human person by phone if possible. Each attempt, we are assured the app should work properly. Each time, it does not. It has been discouraging to lose so much data from an app we used regularly to monitor our financial health. I am still giving two stars in hopes it can be truly resolved, because when working properly, this app was a game changer for our finances.

Rocket Money is an app designed for millennials to hand over their important banking information to Rocket Mortgage in exchange for "help cancelling subscriptions".

The subscription model seems to profit off of inertia/inaction/forgetfulness/laziness. There's a whole app called rocket money to fight back against the subscription model by helping you find and cancel subs. I've never used it and don't plan to but it would be cool if it helped push back against the modern shift towards subscription-everything. Although if we're talking about software or anything else that could easily be one-time/up-front or ongoing, then I guess there's a case to be made that monthly subscriptions let you try before you buy, like rental skis. In that sense they are user friendly.

Upsettingly, this reality is here. Beyond TrueBill, which was brought up in other comments, there are real issues with stopping malicious / anti-pattern subscriptions. Some cases _require you to pay just to stop a recurring charge_. A major villain in this story is gym chains like 24 Hour Fitness, who force you to go in person just to cancel. If you make a very rational choice to work it out with your bank, the bank might still charge you a fee just to stop a recurring payment! Subscriptions are, I think fundamentally, an anti-pattern that should be stopped ASAP.
